title: MediaCaptionsRequested
description: Command from the API to the media worker (queue: media-process): publish a processing version's complete set of subtitle tracks. Convert each source to WebVTT and write a new master playlist, master.c{captions_revision}.m3u8, from the version's base master plus these tracks. Each request carries the whole set, not a change: an empty list means no tracks.

output.description: The processing version's prefix, media/{video_id}/v{processing_version}/. Tracks go under subs/.

base_master_key.description: The version's master playlist without subtitles, as transcoding wrote it. Never overwritten.

captions_revision.description: Increases with every request for this job; names the new master playlist.

language.description: BCP 47 tag, e.g. en, pt-BR, zh-Hant.

kind.description: captions: also describes sounds and music (for deaf and hard-of-hearing viewers).
